name: Vatican City
summary: Vatican Law VIII/2013 adopts the UN drug schedules: possessing personal-use amounts carries 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years. Substances outside UN schedules aren't listed.
poisonControlNote: No Vatican poison centre; Rome's centres are adjacent (e.g. Policlinico Gemelli, +39 06 305 4343, 24h).
callingForHelp: No specific Good Samaritan law found. Emergencies rely on Vatican health services and Rome's 112/118 system; no information found on reporting practice.

law8.title: Vatican City Law No. VIII of 11 July 2013 – Supplementary norms on criminal matters (arts. 41–45)

incb.title: INCB Green List 2026 – psychotropic substances under international control

lsd.note: Controlled via UN schedules (Law VIII/2013): amounts for personal use carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I, so mushrooms containing it are likely covered: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison.

dmt.note: Controlled via UN schedules (Law VIII/2013): amounts for personal use carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years.

mescaline.note: Controlled via UN schedules (Law VIII/2013): amounts for personal use carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years.

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC are UN Schedule I, adopted by Vatican law: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine.

nbomes.note: 25I-, 25B-, 25C-NBOMe are UN Schedule I, adopted by Vatican law: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II, adopted by Vatican law: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison. Other 2C-x may not be covered.

2c-t-x.note: Not on the UN schedules that Vatican law (Law VIII/2013) adopts, and no Vatican list found.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not on the UN schedules that Vatican law (Law VIII/2013) adopts, and no Vatican list found.

cannabis.note: UN-controlled: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine. No medical cannabis framework found.

ketamine.note: Not on the UN schedules adopted by Vatican law and no Vatican list found; a prescription anaesthetic.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016, adopted by Vatican law: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison.

dxm.note: Not on the UN schedules that Vatican law (Law VIII/2013) adopts, and no Vatican list found.

nitrous.note: Not on the UN schedules that Vatican law (Law VIII/2013) adopts, and no Vatican list found.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison; pharmacy supply on prescription is exempt (art. 45).

mdma.note: Controlled via UN schedules (Law VIII/2013): amounts for personal use carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years.

cocaine.note: Controlled via UN schedules (Law VIII/2013): amounts for personal use carry 1 month–1 year prison and up to €1,000 fine; supply 6–20 years.

alcohol.note: Legal; no specific Vatican age rule found.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II, adopted by Vatican law; GBL/1,4-BD are not on UN schedules.

opioids.note: Heroin is UN-controlled: personal-use amounts carry 1 month–1 year prison. Prescription opioids dispensed by pharmacies are exempt.

tramadol.note: Prescription medicine; not on UN schedules.

benzodiazepines.note: UN Schedule IV psychotropics are covered by Law VIII; legal only when dispensed on prescription (art. 45).

maois.note: Harmala alkaloids/Syrian rue are not on the UN schedules adopted by Vatican law; MAOI antidepressants are prescription medicines.
